title: Jump Trading Probability Cup
tech: Python, typed pipelines, probability calibration, walk-forward testing
description: Finalist in the 2026 Jump Trading Probability Cup: 131st of 4,013 entrants (top 3.3%). Built a typed forecasting stack that classifies free-text markets, prices coherent scoreline and prop distributions, and gates model changes with walk-forward tests.

title: LeetHub: Revived & Enhanced
tech: JavaScript, Chrome Extension API (MV3), GitHub API
description: Revived and refactored an unmaintained open-source extension for LeetCode-to-GitHub syncing. Fixed authentication bugs, migrated to Manifest V3, and added repository-linking, backfill, and workflow features.

title: Vibe Semantic Search
tech: Python, FastAPI, React, FAISS, Sentence Transformers, Docker
description: Winner of the 2025 Corner-DSC-BAC Datathon. Built a semantic search engine in 24 hours with FAISS indexing and Sentence Transformer embeddings, served through FastAPI and a responsive frontend.

title: Pennsylvania Toponym Atlas
tech: Python, JavaScript, Leaflet, Census ACS, GeoJSON
description: Built a source-linked interactive atlas from a 2,500-municipality gazetteer, with 68 reviewed map records and evidence beside each claim. Added terrain, coal, urban-area, and demographic context layers while keeping uncertainty visible.

title: NYC Mayoral Forecast
tech: Python, scikit-learn, census data, geospatial analysis, JavaScript
description: Built an out-of-sample forecast of the 2025 NYC Democratic mayoral primary across 4,036 election districts. Trained on earlier election transitions, compared predictions with certified results, and documented baseline performance and limits.

title: iCloud MCP Server
description: Built an HTTP Model Context Protocol server that exposes iCloud Calendar through CalDAV, including typed read/write tools, recurring events, and a read-only research profile. Documented the private deployment and credential boundaries.

title: Exonym Usage in the New York Times
tech: Python, web scraping, corpus analysis, time-series visualization
description: Scraped and de-duplicated 15,000+ New York Times search records from 1900–2025 to trace Peking, Peiping, and Beijing usage, with Kiev/Kyiv as a control. Plotted monthly shares around official renamings and the 1979 NYT style notice.

title: Prime Factorization Game
description: Built a timed factorization game with dynamic difficulty, real-time validation, streaks, and a persistent global leaderboard.
